title: Arithmetic calculations measured by intracranial EEG in the human brain
description: Stereo-EEG recordings from 20 epilepsy surgery candidates performing a sequential three-operand arithmetic task (easy and difficult equations in several stimulus formats). The deposit contains preprocessed, bipolar-referenced epochs spanning -2 to +7 s around the first operand, with MNI coordinates of the bipolar contact pairs. It supports an analysis of the temporal order of activations and interactions in the human brain during arithmetic calculation.
methods_description: Recordings used DIXI Medical SEEG electrodes sampled at 2048 Hz with Natus Quantum amplifiers. Stimuli were presented with PsychToolBox and synchronized to the iEEG via a parallel-port trigger. Preprocessing: low-pass Chebyshev filtering, downsampling to 512 Hz, bipolar referencing, 0.1 Hz high-pass filtering, 50 Hz notch filtering with harmonics, and epoching around the first operand.
